title: Quick Savory Korean Olive Pilaf
description: A funky and light Korean dish featuring pitted black olives, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a festive meal. It is cooked using a bain-marie method to ensure fluffy and flavorful rice.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked white rice, dried seaweed, green onions, soy sauce, and salt to the saucepan.
Stir-fry the mixture for 2 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the pitted black olives to the saucepan and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the saucepan to a bain-marie and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the saucepan from the bain-marie and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Serve the Quick Savory Korean Olive Pilaf hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
